why: The named concern was that omitting --since makes --stream=false start at invocation and miss the initial start. Podman 4.9.3's file and journald readers do not apply that streaming-tail behavior to a nonstreaming read. Agree with the recorded withdrawal for that precise API-default concern, without claiming universal event retention or runtime success.

The reviewed revision's SPEC.md:4744-4746 and SPEC_impl.md:6537-6542 require Podman 4.9.3 or later, making the checked 4.9.3 implementation relevant to the stated supported-engine premise.

Primary source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/containers/podman/v4.9.3/cmd/podman/system/events.go, eventsFlags/eventsCmd (:70-85 in one-based file lines), binds --stream to Stream and sets FromStart for time bounds. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/containers/podman/v4.9.3/pkg/domain/infra/abi/events.go:10-12 forwards Stream unchanged. These facts alone would not refute the concern.

Primary source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/containers/podman/v4.9.3/libpod/events/logfile.go:75-81 explicitly sets the seek origin to the beginning when !options.Stream, independently of FromStart.

Primary source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/containers/podman/v4.9.3/libpod/events/journal_linux.go:100-150 opens the journal and seeks to its tail only when no time bounds AND options.Stream. :236-244 reads forward and returns at EOF when nonstreaming. Its vendored sdjournal.NewJournal (:414-429 of vendor/github.com/coreos/go-systemd/v22/sdjournal/journal.go) opens the local journal without a tail seek.

All checks were source reads. No event capture, test execution or reproduction was performed. Event loss/rotation, an events=none engine, journal access restrictions and other versions are outside the narrowly refuted claim and were not promoted into new findings.
